videos.caption: You have to choose one: Vaporeon, Jolteon, or Flareon? That choice is basically the whole idea behind this colored sand art piece. Eevee sits in the center while the original three Eeveelutions surround it, so you can see all three possible Gen 1 outcomes at the same time. What makes this group especially fun visually is that they barely feel like simple recolors of one another. Jolteon becomes sharp, angular, and electric yellow. Vaporeon completely changes direction with blue aquatic features, fins, and a long tail. Flareon keeps more of Eevee’s fluffy shape but turns it into a warm orange-and-cream Fire-type design. Then Eevee stays right in the middle as the little neutral starting point connecting all three. Every colored section is made with sand, so the yellows, blues, oranges, creams, browns, and smaller details all have that soft granular texture instead of a flat painted finish. For anyone into Eevee, Eeveelutions, Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Pokémon evolution art, Gen 1 Pokémon nostalgia, colored sand art, satisfying art processes, fan art, or ASMR-style craft videos, this one combines all of those in a single piece. satisfying sand art ASMR

Kinetic sand is a great way to provide sensory input while still working on a multitude of skills.  I love to use cookie cutters in the sand to work on bilateral skills, pressure and and force regulation.  Cutting with sand is a great introduction to snipping and provides additional sensory feedback. Kids who are struggling with writing tend to be more willing to practice writing on different surfaces. Try sand and use a paint brush for smooth lines.  #occupationaltherapy #ot #sensoryactivities #finemotorskills #sensory #schoolbasedot
